text:
marta_finance: Heads-up: customer BrightLabs opened a dispute on the Feb invoice citing a big spike on 2026-02-15. They reported streaming usage much higher than normal. Pasting support note.
lee_support: customer: 'We saw ~2.2M tokens for /v1/streams on 2026-02-15, ~10x our normal day. Please pause billing while you investigate.'
marta_finance: @alejandra_runtime can you check runtime deploys around that date/time for anything that might affect streaming metering keys or idempotency?
alejandra_runtime: We had a short deploy that changed the stream ACK persist key at ~03:12 UTC 2026-02-15. Canary showed duplicate emits. Possible duplicate token windows when sessions reconnected. Example trace:
```
[2026-02-15T03:12:06Z] req=rx_9z stream_init session=se-81
[2026-02-15T03:12:07Z] req=rx_9z token_emit count=1203 seq=11
[2026-02-15T03:12:08Z] session_disconnect se-81 reason=timeout
[2026-02-15T03:12:09Z] session_reconnect se-81 resync token_emit count=1203 seq=11
```
alejandra_runtime: If the persistence key changed mid-flight, the dedupe partitioning could miss the duplicate and both emits would be counted.
sam_sre: We detected the regression and rolled back the change at 03:14 UTC. Correlation window ~2 minutes. I'll pull deploy metadata and impacted account list.
olga_prodops: Is this isolated? We should confirm scope before issuing credits.
lee_support: No other CS flags yet; pinged the rest of CS. BrightLabs provided three request_ids for cross-check.
alejandra_runtime: Discovery plan: run a readonly query to find duplicate (request_id, event_seq) pairs in the 03:10-03:16 UTC window, then compute duplicate token totals per account. Example SQL (readonly):
```
SELECT account_id, request_id, event_seq, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM metering.stream_events
WHERE emitted_at >= '2026-02-15T03:10:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND emitted_at <= '2026-02-15T03:16:00Z'::timestamptz
GROUP BY account_id, request_id, event_seq
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
alejandra_runtime: I'll run discovery and publish counts. If validated, I'll populate a billing_corrections table with token_dedup, checksum, and audit fields for billing to ingest. Estimated discovery 1h, backfill/correction script 2-3h, safe write 1h.
marta_finance: Finance provisional credit policy: isolated incidents under $20k can be provisionally credited pending verification. Need ops lead signoff and a billing ticket.
billing-bot: Created billing ticket CB-3348 linked to INV-2026-02-BRIGHTLABS.
sam_sre: Found duplicates concentrated in the 03:12:00-03:14:30 UTC window. Alejandra, any early numbers for BrightLabs?
alejandra_runtime: Readonly discovery: BrightLabs duplicate token windows=17 total_duplicate_tokens=1,865,720. I'll compute USD at their per-token rate and produce an audit table.
marta_finance: Approving provisional credit up to $19,000 pending verification. Please include exact token->USD calc, unit price, rounding, and change id.
olga_prodops: I'll own comms and postmortem. Assigning owners: alejandra_runtime -> dedupe & correction, lee_support -> customer comms, marta_finance -> credit signoff, sam_sre -> infra postmortem.
billing-bot: Provisional credit issued CR-9102 amount=$18,650 status=pending-verification.
lee_support: Told BrightLabs we'll provisionally credit while we verify and will confirm final adjustment after audit. They acknowledged.
alejandra_runtime: Starting backfill under maintenance lock in 10 minutes. Will snapshot correction rows for audit and push to staging billing table for manual review before ingest. ETA ~3 hours.
marta_finance: Please keep this thread updated with verification artifacts (checksums, query outputs, and exact USD math).
